narrative.summary: ISSUER_ROLE is the weakest path on this token - its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was revoked on 2026-07-30, so no address currently holds the power to reassign that role.
narrative.detail: A revoked DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE cuts both ways: nobody can currently reassign ISSUER_ROLE at will, a real hardening - but it also removes any on-chain path to rotate away from the current issuer if it were ever compromised, short of a contract upgrade outside this role system entirely.

cheapest_fix.what: a confirmed delay before changes apply

main_gap.reason: Too few people need to agree

independent_read.why: no admin slot, owner(), admin(), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member or authority() answered
